forceNightlightOff.title: Force Nightlight Off
forceNightlightOff.description: Pura turns the nightlight on/off with the diffuser. If enabled, the plugin will send a nightlight off command right after turning on a diffuser.

enableFanService.title: Enable Intensity Control
enableFanService.description: Replaces the on/off switch with intensity control (Subtle, Medium, Strong). Changing this may require recreating HomeKit scenes or automations for all Pura diffusers in this plugin.

enableNightlightAccessory.title: Enable Nightlight Controls
enableNightlightAccessory.description: Adds a separate Nightlight accessory tile for compatible diffusers (On, Brightness, and Color). You can group it with the diffuser in the Home app if desired.
